messages.content:
A reader of a contract claims that the quoted passages below settle a statement (the hypothesis). You do not see the contract; judge only from the quotes.

<hypothesis>
Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
</hypothesis>

<claimed_label>
Contradiction
</claimed_label>

<quotes>
<quote>all analyses, compilations, data, studies, notes, interpretations, memoranda or other documents prepared by a party or its Representatives containing or based in whole or in part on any such furnished information are collectively referred to herein as the "Confidential Information;"</quote>
<quote>concerning its business prospects, financial condition, operations, assets and liabilities</quote>
</quotes>

The labels mean:
- Entailment: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is false.

Decide whether the quotes, taken as written, are enough on their own to support the claimed label. Answer supports = false if the quotes are about something else, support the opposite label, support only part of the hypothesis, or need context the quotes do not give.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: supports (true or false) and a one-sentence reason.

content.text: {"supports":true,"reason":"The quotes show Confidential Information covers non-technical material such as business prospects, financial condition, operations, assets and liabilities, plus analyses, notes and memoranda based on them, so it is not limited to technical information."}
